Memperbarui komponen upload untuk menggunakan hooks dan membuat halaman admin. Memeriksa apakah `imagekitio-react` perlu diinstal:



Memperbarui komponen upload agar terintegrasi dengan hooks dan membuat halaman admin. Menggunakan pendekatan yang lebih sederhana tanpa `imagekitio-react` terlebih dulu:



Membuat komponen upload yang lebih sederhana menggunakan API route untuk upload ke ImageKit. Membuat API route upload terlebih dulu:


```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import ImageKit from 'imagekit';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    const formData = await request.formData();
    const file = formData.get('file') as File;
    const folder = formData.get('folder') as string || '/waiting-list';

    if (!file) {
      return NextResponse.json(
        { error: 'No file provided' },
        { status: 400 },
      );
    }

    const imagekit = new ImageKit({
      publicKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY || '',
      privateKey: process.env.IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY || '',
      urlEndpoint: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL || '',
    });

    // Convert file to base64
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);
    const base64 = buffer.toString('base64');

    // Upload to ImageKit
    const result = await imagekit.upload({
      file: base64,
      fileName: file.name,
      folder: folder,
    });

    return NextResponse.json({
      url: result.url,
      fileId: result.fileId,
      name: result.name,
      size: result.size,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ImageKit Upload] Error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to upload file' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

```

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/app/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/app/components/ui/card';
import { Upload, X, Image as ImageIcon, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';

export interface UploadedImage {
  url: string;
  fileId?: string;
  fileName?: string;
}

interface ImageUploadProps {
  maxImages?: number;
  existingImages?: UploadedImage[];
  onImagesChange?: (images: UploadedImage[]) => void;
  folder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function ImageUpload({
  maxImages = 3,
  existingImages = [],
  onImagesChange,
  folder = '/waiting-list',
  disabled = false,
}: ImageUploadProps) {
  const [images, setImages] = useState<UploadedImage[]>(existingImages);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const handleUploadSuccess = useCallback(
    (response: any) => {
      const newImage: UploadedImage = {
        url: response.url,
        fileId: response.fileId,
        fileName: response.name,
      };

      const updatedImages = [...images, newImage];
      setImages(updatedImages);
      onImagesChange?.(updatedImages);
      setUploading(false);
    },
    [images, onImagesChange],
  );

  const handleUploadError = useCallback((error: any) => {
    console.error('Image upload error:', error);
    setUploading(false);
    // TODO: Show toast error
  });

  const handleRemoveImage = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      const updatedImages = images.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
      setImages(updatedImages);
      onImagesChange?.(updatedImages);
    },
    [images, onImagesChange],
  );

  const canUpload = images.length < maxImages && !disabled && !uploading;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Upload Images</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {images.length}/{maxImages} images uploaded
          </p>
        </div>
        {canUpload && (
          <IKContext
            urlEndpoint={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL || ''}
            publicKey={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY || ''}
            authenticationEndpoint="/api/imagekit/auth"
          >
            <IKUpload
              fileName={`waiting-list-${Date.now()}`}
              folder={folder}
              onSuccess={handleUploadSuccess}
              onError={handleUploadError}
              onUploadStart={() => setUploading(true)}
            >
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={!canUpload}
              >
                <Upload className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Upload Image
              </Button>
            </IKUpload>
          </IKContext>
        )}
      </div>

      {uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Uploading image...
              </span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {images.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {images.map((image, index) => (
            <Card key={index} className="relative group">
              <CardContent className="p-2">
                <div className="relative aspect-video w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
                  <Image
                    src={image.url}
                    alt={`Uploaded image ${index + 1}`}
                    fill
                    className="object-cover"
                  />
                  {!disabled && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="destructive"
                      size="icon"
                      className="absolute top-2 right-2 h-6 w-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveImage(index)}
                    >
                      <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {images.length === 0 && !uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <ImageIcon className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              No images uploaded yet
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


```

```typescriptreact
  const [images, setImages] = useState<UploadedImage[]>(existingImages);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFileSelect = useCallback(
    async (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = event.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;

      // Validate file type
      if (!file.type.startsWith('image/')) {
        alert('Please select an image file');
        return;
      }

      // Validate file size (max 5MB)
      if (file.size > 5 * 1024 * 1024) {
        alert('File size must be less than 5MB');
        return;
      }

      setUploading(true);

      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        formData.append('folder', folder);

        const response = await fetch('/api/imagekit/upload', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Upload failed');
        }

        const result = await response.json();

        const newImage: UploadedImage = {
          url: result.url,
          fileId: result.fileId,
          fileName: result.name,
        };

        const updatedImages = [...images, newImage];
        setImages(updatedImages);
        onImagesChange?.(updatedImages);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Image upload error:', error);
        alert('Failed to upload image. Please try again.');
      } finally {
        setUploading(false);
        // Reset file input
        if (fileInputRef.current) {
          fileInputRef.current.value = '';
        }
      }
    },
    [images, onImagesChange, folder],
  );

'use client';

import { useState, useCallback, useRef } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/app/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/app/components/ui/card';
import { Upload, X, Video, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import Image from 'next/image';

export interface UploadedVideo {
  url: string;
  thumbnailUrl?: string;
  fileId?: string;
  fileName?: string;
}

interface VideoUploadProps {
  maxVideos?: number;
  existingVideos?: UploadedVideo[];
  onVideosChange?: (videos: UploadedVideo[]) => void;
  folder?: string;
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export function VideoUpload({
  maxVideos = 1,
  existingVideos = [],
  onVideosChange,
  folder = '/waiting-list/videos',
  disabled = false,
}: VideoUploadProps) {
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<UploadedVideo[]>(existingVideos);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  const handleUploadSuccess = useCallback(
    (response: any) => {
      const newVideo: UploadedVideo = {
        url: response.url,
        thumbnailUrl: response.thumbnailUrl,
        fileId: response.fileId,
        fileName: response.name,
      };

      const updatedVideos = [...videos, newVideo];
      setVideos(updatedVideos);
      onVideosChange?.(updatedVideos);
      setUploading(false);
    },
    [videos, onVideosChange],
  );

  const handleUploadError = useCallback((error: any) => {
    console.error('Video upload error:', error);
    setUploading(false);
    // TODO: Show toast error
  });

  const handleRemoveVideo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      const updatedVideos = videos.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
      setVideos(updatedVideos);
      onVideosChange?.(updatedVideos);
    },
    [videos, onVideosChange],
  );

  const canUpload = videos.length < maxVideos && !disabled && !uploading;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Upload Video</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {videos.length}/{maxVideos} video uploaded
          </p>
        </div>
        {canUpload && (
          <IKContext
            urlEndpoint={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL || ''}
            publicKey={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY || ''}
            authenticationEndpoint="/api/imagekit/auth"
          >
            <IKUpload
              fileName={`waiting-list-video-${Date.now()}`}
              folder={folder}
              onSuccess={handleUploadSuccess}
              onError={handleUploadError}
              onUploadStart={() => setUploading(true)}
            >
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={!canUpload}
              >
                <Upload className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Upload Video
              </Button>
            </IKUpload>
          </IKContext>
        )}
      </div>

      {uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Uploading video...
              </span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {videos.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {videos.map((video, index) => (
            <Card key={index} className="relative group">
              <CardContent className="p-2">
                <div className="relative aspect-video w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
                  {video.thumbnailUrl ? (
                    <Image
                      src={video.thumbnailUrl}
                      alt={`Video thumbnail ${index + 1}`}
                      fill
                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
                      <Video className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {!disabled && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="destructive"
                      size="icon"
                      className="absolute top-2 right-2 h-6 w-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveVideo(index)}
                    >
                      <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {videos.length === 0 && !uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <Video className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              No video uploaded yet
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import Image from 'next/image';

  url: string;
  thumbnailUrl?: string;

}

interface VideoUploadProps {

  onVideosChange?: (videos: UploadedVideo[]) => void;

  disabled?: boolean;

export function VideoUpload({
  maxVideos = 1,
  existingVideos = [],
  onVideosChange,
  folder = '/waiting-list/videos',
  disabled = false,
}: VideoUploadProps) {
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<UploadedVideo[]>(existingVideos);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  const handleFileSelect = useCallback(
    async (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      const file = event.target.files?.[0];
      if (!file) return;

      // Validate file type
      if (!file.type.startsWith('video/')) {
        alert('Please select a video file');
        return;
      }

      // Validate file size (max 50MB)
      if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
        alert('File size must be less than 50MB');
        return;
      }

      setUploading(true);

      try {
        const formData = new FormData();
        formData.append('file', file);
        formData.append('folder', folder);

        const response = await fetch('/api/imagekit/upload', {
          method: 'POST',
          body: formData,
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
          throw new Error('Upload failed');
        }

        const result = await response.json();

        const newVideo: UploadedVideo = {
          url: result.url,
          thumbnailUrl: result.thumbnailUrl,
          fileId: result.fileId,
          fileName: result.name,
        };

        const updatedVideos = [...videos, newVideo];
        setVideos(updatedVideos);
        onVideosChange?.(updatedVideos);
      } catch (error) {
        console.error('Video upload error:', error);
        alert('Failed to upload video. Please try again.');
      } finally {
        setUploading(false);
        // Reset file input
        if (fileInputRef.current) {
          fileInputRef.current.value = '';
        }
      }
    },
    [videos, onVideosChange, folder],
  );

  const handleRemoveVideo = useCallback(
    (index: number) => {
      const updatedVideos = videos.filter((_, i) => i !== index);
      setVideos(updatedVideos);
      onVideosChange?.(updatedVideos);
    },
    [videos, onVideosChange],
  );

  const canUpload = videos.length < maxVideos && !disabled && !uploading;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <h3 className="text-sm font-medium">Upload Video</h3>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {videos.length}/{maxVideos} video uploaded
          </p>
        </div>
        {canUpload && (
          <IKContext
            urlEndpoint={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL || ''}
            publicKey={process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY || ''}
            authenticationEndpoint="/api/imagekit/auth"
          >
            <IKUpload
              fileName={`waiting-list-video-${Date.now()}`}
              folder={folder}
              onSuccess={handleUploadSuccess}
              onError={handleUploadError}
              onUploadStart={() => setUploading(true)}
            >
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={!canUpload}
              >
                <Upload className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                Upload Video
              </Button>
            </IKUpload>
          </IKContext>
        )}
      </div>

      {uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
              <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                Uploading video...
              </span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {videos.length > 0 && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          {videos.map((video, index) => (
            <Card key={index} className="relative group">
              <CardContent className="p-2">
                <div className="relative aspect-video w-full rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted">
                  {video.thumbnailUrl ? (
                    <Image
                      src={video.thumbnailUrl}
                      alt={`Video thumbnail ${index + 1}`}
                      fill
                      className="object-cover"
                    />
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-center h-full">
                      <Video className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground" />
                    </div>
                  )}
                  {!disabled && (
                    <Button
                      type="button"
                      variant="destructive"
                      size="icon"
                      className="absolute top-2 right-2 h-6 w-6 opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-100 transition-opacity"
                      onClick={() => handleRemoveVideo(index)}
                    >
                      <X className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {videos.length === 0 && !uploading && (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-8 text-center">
            <Video className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground mb-2" />
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              No video uploaded yet
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

Membuat halaman admin untuk mengelola waiting list. Memeriksa struktur yang ada:


```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/app/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/app/components/ui/button';
import { ImageUpload, UploadedImage } from '@/components/upload/ImageUpload';
import { VideoUpload, UploadedVideo } from '@/components/upload/VideoUpload';
import { useUploadImages } from '@/queryHooks/useUploadImages';
import { useUploadVideos } from '@/queryHooks/useUploadVideos';
import { Loader2, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export default function WaitingListPage() {
  const [waitingListId, setWaitingListId] = useState('');
  const [images, setImages] = useState<UploadedImage[]>([]);
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<UploadedVideo[]>([]);

  const uploadImagesMutation = useUploadImages();
  const uploadVideosMutation = useUploadVideos();

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!waitingListId.trim()) {
      toast.error('Waiting List ID is required');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Upload images if any
      if (images.length > 0) {
        await uploadImagesMutation.mutateAsync({
          waitingListId: waitingListId.trim(),
          images: images.map((img, index) => ({
            imageURL: img.url,
            isPrimary: index === 0,
            seq: index,
          })),
        });
        toast.success(`${images.length} image(s) uploaded successfully`);
      }

      // Upload videos if any (disabled for waiting list)
      if (videos.length > 0) {
        await uploadVideosMutation.mutateAsync({
          waitingListId: waitingListId.trim(),
          videos: videos.map((vid, index) => ({
            videoURL: vid.url,
            thumbnailURL: vid.thumbnailUrl,
            isPrimary: index === 0,
            seq: index,
          })),
        });
        toast.success(`${videos.length} video(s) uploaded successfully`);
      }

      // Reset form
      setImages([]);
      setVideos([]);
      toast.success('All uploads completed successfully');
    } catch (error: any) {
      toast.error(error.message || 'Failed to save uploads');
    }
  };

  const isLoading = uploadImagesMutation.isPending || uploadVideosMutation.isPending;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto py-6 space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Manage Waiting List</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
          Upload images and videos for waiting list items
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Upload Media</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">
              Waiting List ID
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={waitingListId}
              onChange={(e) => setWaitingListId(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter waiting list ID"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <ImageUpload
              maxImages={3}
              existingImages={images}
              onImagesChange={setImages}
              folder="/waiting-list"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <VideoUpload
              maxVideos={0}
              existingVideos={videos}
              onVideosChange={setVideos}
              folder="/waiting-list/videos"
              disabled={true}
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              Video upload is disabled for waiting list (max: 0 videos)
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={isLoading || !waitingListId.trim() || (images.length === 0 && videos.length === 0)}
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                  Saving...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  Save Uploads
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

```typescript
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import ImageKit from 'imagekit';

export const runtime = 'nodejs';

export async function GET() {
  try {
    const imagekit = new ImageKit({
      publicKey: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY || '',
      privateKey: process.env.IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY || '',
      urlEndpoint: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL || '',
    });

    const authenticationParameters = imagekit.getAuthenticationParameters();

    return NextResponse.json(authenticationParameters);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[ImageKit Auth] Error:', error);
    return NextResponse.json(
      { error: 'Failed to generate authentication parameters' },
      { status: 500 },
    );
  }
}

```typescript
'use client';

import { useMutation } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { api } from '@/config/axios.config';

export interface UploadImageItem {
  imageURL: string;
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  isPrimary?: boolean;
  seq?: number;
}

interface UploadImagesPayload {
  waitingListId: string;
  branchId?: string;
  images: UploadImageItem[];
}

interface UploadImagesResponse {
  message: string;
  data: Array<{
    id: string;
    imageURL: string;
    title?: string;
    description?: string;
    isPrimary: boolean;
    seq: number;
  }>;
}

export const useUploadImages = () => {
  return useMutation<UploadImagesResponse, Error, UploadImagesPayload>({
    mutationFn: async (payload) => {
      try {
        const { data } = await api.post<UploadImagesResponse>(
          '/wks/images/batch',
          payload,
        );
        return data;
      } catch (error) {
        const err = error as { response?: { data?: { message?: string } }; message?: string };
        throw new Error(
          err?.response?.data?.message ||
            err?.message ||
            'Gagal mengupload images.',
        );
      }
    },
  });
};

## Summary

### 1. **Component Upload Modular**
- **`components/upload/ImageUpload.tsx`**: Komponen upload image (max 3 images untuk waiting list)
- **`components/upload/VideoUpload.tsx`**: Komponen upload video (disabled untuk waiting list, max 0)
- **`components/upload/index.ts`**: Export file untuk komponen

### 2. **API Routes untuk ImageKit**
- **`app/api/imagekit/auth/route.ts`**: Endpoint autentikasi ImageKit
- **`app/api/imagekit/upload/route.ts`**: Endpoint upload file ke ImageKit (server-side)

### 3. **Hooks untuk Upload**
- **`queryHooks/useUploadImages.ts`**: Hook untuk upload batch images ke backend
- **`queryHooks/useUploadVideos.ts`**: Hook untuk upload batch videos ke backend

### 4. **Halaman Admin**
- **`app/(dashboard)/waiting-list/page.tsx`**: Halaman admin untuk manage waiting list dengan upload images/videos

### Fitur yang sudah diimplementasikan:
- Upload image via ImageKit (max 3 untuk waiting list)
- Upload video disabled untuk waiting list (max 0)
- Preview images setelah upload
- Remove images sebelum save
- Validasi file type dan size
- Loading state saat upload
- Error handling dengan toast notifications
- Component reusable untuk waiting-list dan workshop (nanti)

### Next Steps:
1. Test upload functionality
2. Tambahkan list waiting list di halaman admin (bukan hanya input ID manual)
3. Integrate ke workshop management page (ketika sudah berlangganan)

Semua komponen sudah modular dan bisa digunakan di 2 tempat:
- **waiting-list** (wks_waitingList) - max 3 images, 0 videos
- **workshop** (sys_company) - nanti bisa dikonfigurasi berbeda

# 📋 Waiting List Management - Setup Guide

## ✅ Yang Sudah Dibuat

### 1. **Component Upload Modular**
- ✅ `components/upload/ImageUpload.tsx` - Upload images (max 3 untuk waiting list)
- ✅ `components/upload/VideoUpload.tsx` - Upload videos (disabled untuk waiting list, max 0)
- ✅ `components/upload/index.ts` - Export file

### 2. **API Routes**
- ✅ `app/api/imagekit/auth/route.ts` - ImageKit authentication
- ✅ `app/api/imagekit/upload/route.ts` - Upload file ke ImageKit (server-side)

### 3. **Hooks**
- ✅ `queryHooks/useUploadImages.ts` - Hook untuk upload batch images
- ✅ `queryHooks/useUploadVideos.ts` - Hook untuk upload batch videos

### 4. **Halaman Admin**
- ✅ `app/(dashboard)/waiting-list/page.tsx` - Halaman untuk manage waiting list

## 🚀 Cara Setup Menu

### Step 1: Insert Menu ke Database

1. Buka database client (pgAdmin, DBeaver, atau psql)
2. Connect ke database ngebengkel
3. Jalankan script SQL dari file:
   ```
   server-ngebengkel/prisma/seed-waiting-list-menu.sql
   ```

   Atau copy paste langsung:

```sql
-- Insert parent menu "Waiting List"
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 16, NULL, 'Waiting List', NULL, 'WKS', 'menu', true, 'List', '1', 'system', NOW(), NOW()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 16);

-- Insert submenu "Manage Waiting List"
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 17, 16, 'Manage Waiting List', '/waiting-list', 'WKS', 'submenu', false, 'Upload', '1', 'system', NOW(), NOW()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 17);
```

### Step 2: Set Permission

Setelah menu ter-insert, set permission untuk user roles yang perlu akses:

```sql
-- Cari userCompanyRole_id yang perlu akses (contoh: admin)
SELECT id, role_id FROM sys_UserCompanyRole WHERE role_id = 'ADMIN';

-- Set permission untuk menu parent (id=16) dan submenu (id=17)
-- Ganti userCompanyRole_id dengan ID yang sesuai
INSERT INTO sys_Menu_Permission (userCompanyRole_id, menu_id, can_view, can_create, can_edit, can_delete, can_print, can_approve, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt)
VALUES 
  (1, 16, true, true, true, false, false, false, 'Active', 'system', NOW()),  -- Parent menu
  (1, 17, true, true, true, false, false, false, 'Active', 'system', NOW());  -- Submenu
```

### Step 3: Verifikasi

1. Login ke aplikasi sebagai user dengan permission yang sudah di-set
2. Menu "Waiting List" akan muncul di sidebar (module WKS)
3. Klik "Manage Waiting List" untuk akses halaman upload
4. Path: `/waiting-list`

## 📝 Cara Menggunakan

1. **Akses Halaman**: Klik menu "Waiting List" > "Manage Waiting List" di sidebar
2. **Input Waiting List ID**: Masukkan ID waiting list yang akan di-upload media-nya
3. **Upload Images**: 
   - Klik "Upload Image"
   - Pilih file image (max 5MB per file)
   - Max 3 images untuk waiting list
   - Preview akan muncul setelah upload
4. **Upload Videos**: 
   - Disabled untuk waiting list (max 0 videos)
5. **Save**: Klik "Save Uploads" untuk menyimpan ke database

## 🔧 Konfigurasi

### Environment Variables

Pastikan sudah set di `.env.local`:

```env
# ImageKit Configuration
NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_URL=https://ik.imagekit.io/your_imagekit_id
NEXT_PUBLIC_IMAGEKIT_PUBLIC_KEY=your_public_key
IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY=your_private_key
```

### Limit Upload

- **Waiting List**: Max 3 images, 0 videos
- **Workshop** (nanti): Bisa dikonfigurasi berbeda (max 5 images, 1 video)

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Menu tidak muncul di sidebar?
- ✅ Pastikan menu sudah di-insert ke database
- ✅ Pastikan permission sudah di-set untuk user role
- ✅ Refresh browser atau clear cache
- ✅ Cek console untuk error

### Upload gagal?
- ✅ Pastikan ImageKit credentials sudah benar di `.env.local`
- ✅ Cek file size (max 5MB untuk image, 50MB untuk video)
- ✅ Cek file type (harus image/* untuk images, video/* untuk videos)
- ✅ Cek console untuk error message

### Images tidak muncul setelah upload?
- ✅ Pastikan waiting list ID sudah benar
- ✅ Cek network tab untuk response dari API
- ✅ Pastikan backend endpoint `/wks/images/batch` berfungsi

```typescriptreact
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from '@/app/components/ui/card';
import { Button } from '@/app/components/ui/button';
import { ImageUpload, UploadedImage } from '@/components/upload/ImageUpload';
import { VideoUpload, UploadedVideo } from '@/components/upload/VideoUpload';
import { useUploadImages } from '@/queryHooks/useUploadImages';
import { useUploadVideos } from '@/queryHooks/useUploadVideos';
import { Loader2, Save } from 'lucide-react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export default function WaitingListPage() {
  const [waitingListId, setWaitingListId] = useState('');
  const [images, setImages] = useState<UploadedImage[]>([]);
  const [videos, setVideos] = useState<UploadedVideo[]>([]);

  const uploadImagesMutation = useUploadImages();
  const uploadVideosMutation = useUploadVideos();

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!waitingListId.trim()) {
      toast.error('Waiting List ID is required');
      return;
    }

    try {
      // Upload images if any
      if (images.length > 0) {
        await uploadImagesMutation.mutateAsync({
          waitingListId: waitingListId.trim(),
          images: images.map((img, index) => ({
            imageURL: img.url,
            isPrimary: index === 0,
            seq: index,
          })),
        });
        toast.success(`${images.length} image(s) uploaded successfully`);
      }

      // Upload videos if any (disabled for waiting list)
      if (videos.length > 0) {
        await uploadVideosMutation.mutateAsync({
          waitingListId: waitingListId.trim(),
          videos: videos.map((vid, index) => ({
            videoURL: vid.url,
            thumbnailURL: vid.thumbnailUrl,
            isPrimary: index === 0,
            seq: index,
          })),
        });
        toast.success(`${videos.length} video(s) uploaded successfully`);
      }

      // Reset form
      setImages([]);
      setVideos([]);
      toast.success('All uploads completed successfully');
    } catch (error) {
      const err = error as { message?: string };
      toast.error(err?.message || 'Failed to save uploads');
    }
  };

  const isLoading = uploadImagesMutation.isPending || uploadVideosMutation.isPending;

  return (
    <div className="container mx-auto py-6 space-y-6">
      <div>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">Manage Waiting List</h1>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">
          Upload images and videos for waiting list items
        </p>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>Upload Media</CardTitle>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="space-y-6">
          <div>
            <label className="text-sm font-medium mb-2 block">
              Waiting List ID
            </label>
            <input
              type="text"
              value={waitingListId}
              onChange={(e) => setWaitingListId(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="Enter waiting list ID"
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-md"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <ImageUpload
              maxImages={3}
              existingImages={images}
              onImagesChange={setImages}
              folder="/waiting-list"
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <VideoUpload
              maxVideos={0}
              existingVideos={videos}
              onVideosChange={setVideos}
              folder="/waiting-list/videos"
              disabled={true}
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-2">
              Video upload is disabled for waiting list (max: 0 videos)
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex justify-end">
            <Button
              onClick={handleSave}
              disabled={isLoading || !waitingListId.trim() || (images.length === 0 && videos.length === 0)}
            >
              {isLoading ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 mr-2 animate-spin" />
                  Saving...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                  Save Uploads
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}


```

Menyiapkan script insert untuk `sys_Menu` dan `sys_Menu_Permission` untuk admin panel. Memeriksa skema Prisma terlebih dahulu:



Menyusun script SQL untuk insert menu dan permission admin panel. Memeriksa module_id yang tersedia:


```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- INSERT MENU UNTUK ADMIN PANEL (admin-ngebengkel)
-- ============================================================================
-- Script ini untuk membuat menu di admin panel yang terpisah dari client-ngebengkel
-- Admin panel digunakan untuk mengatur seluruh workshop dan waiting list
-- 
-- Cara menjalankan:
-- 1. Buka database client (pgAdmin, DBeaver, atau psql)
-- 2. Connect ke database ngebengkel
-- 3. Copy paste dan jalankan script ini
-- 4. Setelah menu ter-insert, set permission untuk admin roles
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- PART 1: INSERT MENU ITEMS
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Insert parent menu "Admin Panel" atau "Workshop Management"
-- ID 18 digunakan (cek dulu apakah sudah terpakai, adjust jika perlu)
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)
  'Admin Panel',  -- Judul menu (bisa diganti: "Workshop Management", "System Admin", dll)
  NULL,  -- Tidak ada href untuk parent menu
  'SYS',  -- Module System (atau bisa 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai)
  'menu',  -- Tipe menu
  true,  -- Memiliki child
  'Settings',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Shield", "Cog", "Wrench", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 18
);

-- 2. Insert submenu "Manage Workshops" (untuk mengatur seluruh workshop)
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  19,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Manage Workshops',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/workshops',  -- Path ke halaman (adjust sesuai routing admin-ngebengkel)
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'Building',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Store", "Building2", "Factory", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 19
);

-- 3. Insert submenu "Manage Waiting List" (untuk mengatur seluruh waiting list)
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  20,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Manage Waiting List',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/waiting-list',  -- Path ke halaman (adjust sesuai routing admin-ngebengkel)
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'List',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "FileText", "ClipboardList", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 20
);

-- 4. (Optional) Insert submenu "Workshop Analytics" atau menu lain yang diperlukan
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  21,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Workshop Analytics',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/analytics',  -- Path ke halaman
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'BarChart',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "TrendingUp", "Activity", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 21
);

```markdown
# 🎛️ Admin Panel Menu Setup Guide

## 📋 Overview

Script ini untuk membuat menu di **admin-ngebengkel** (admin panel terpisah dari client-ngebengkel) yang digunakan untuk mengatur seluruh workshop dan waiting list.

## 🗂️ Struktur Menu yang Akan Dibuat

```
Admin Panel (id: 18)
├── Manage Workshops (id: 19) → /admin/workshops
├── Manage Waiting List (id: 20) → /admin/waiting-list
└── Workshop Analytics (id: 21) → /admin/analytics (Optional)
```

## 🚀 Cara Setup

### Step 1: Cek ID Menu yang Tersedia

Sebelum menjalankan script, pastikan ID menu (18, 19, 20, 21) belum terpakai:

```sql
SELECT id, menu_description, href 
FROM sys_Menu 
WHERE id IN (18, 19, 20, 21);
```

Jika ada yang sudah terpakai, adjust ID di script.

### Step 2: Cek Role yang Ada

Cek role yang ada di sistem untuk permission:

```sql
SELECT id, role_id, role_name 
FROM sys_UserRole 
WHERE role_id IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER');
```

Sesuaikan role_id di script jika berbeda.

### Step 3: Jalankan Script

1. Buka database client (pgAdmin, DBeaver, atau psql)
2. Connect ke database ngebengkel
3. Jalankan script dari file:
   ```
   server-ngebengkel/prisma/seed-admin-panel-menu.sql
   ```

### Step 4: Verifikasi

Jalankan query verifikasi:

```sql
-- Cek menu yang sudah ter-insert
SELECT id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, icon 
FROM sys_Menu 
WHERE id IN (18, 19, 20, 21)
ORDER BY id;

-- Cek permission yang sudah ter-insert
SELECT 
  mp.menu_id,
  m.menu_description,
  COUNT(mp.userCompanyRole_id) as total_permissions
FROM sys_Menu_Permission mp
JOIN sys_Menu m ON mp.menu_id = m.id
WHERE mp.menu_id IN (18, 19, 20, 21)
GROUP BY mp.menu_id, m.menu_description
ORDER BY mp.menu_id;
```

## ⚙️ Konfigurasi

### Menu Items

| ID | Menu | Path | Icon | Module |
|----|------|------|------|--------|
| 18 | Admin Panel | - | Settings | SYS |
| 19 | Manage Workshops | /admin/workshops | Building | SYS |
| 20 | Manage Waiting List | /admin/waiting-list | List | SYS |
| 21 | Workshop Analytics | /admin/analytics | BarChart | SYS |

### Permission Settings

- **Parent Menu (Admin Panel)**: Full access (view, create, edit, delete, approve)
- **Manage Workshops**: Full access (view, create, edit, delete, approve)
- **Manage Waiting List**: Full access (view, create, edit, delete, approve)
- **Workshop Analytics**: Read-only (view, print only)

### Roles yang Mendapat Akses

Default: `ADMIN`, `SUPER_ADMIN`, `OWNER`

Sesuaikan di script jika role berbeda.

## 🔧 Customization

### Mengubah Path Menu

Edit bagian `href` di script:

```sql
-- Contoh: ubah path untuk Manage Workshops
href = '/admin/workshops',  -- Ganti dengan path yang sesuai
```

### Mengubah Icon

Edit bagian `icon` di script. Icon harus sesuai dengan icon library yang digunakan:

- **Lucide React**: `Settings`, `Building`, `List`, `BarChart`, dll
- **Heroicons**: `CogIcon`, `BuildingOfficeIcon`, dll

### Mengubah Module ID

Edit bagian `module_id` di script:

```sql
module_id = 'SYS',  -- atau 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai
```

### Menambah Menu Baru

Copy template dari menu yang ada dan sesuaikan:

```sql
INSERT INTO sys_Menu (id, parent_id, menu_description, href, module_id, menu_type, has_child, icon, iStatus, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt)
SELECT 
  22,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel)
  'Menu Baru',  -- Judul
  '/admin/new-menu',  -- Path
  'SYS',  -- Module
  'submenu',
  false,
  'IconName',
  '1',
  'system',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_Menu WHERE id = 22);
```

## 📍 Routing di admin-ngebengkel

Pastikan routing di Next.js sesuai dengan path menu:

```
admin-ngebengkel/
├── app/
│   └── admin/
│       ├── workshops/
│       │   └── page.tsx          # /admin/workshops
│       ├── waiting-list/
│       │   └── page.tsx          # /admin/waiting-list
│       └── analytics/
│           └── page.tsx          # /admin/analytics
```

## 🐛 Troubleshooting

### Menu tidak muncul di sidebar?

1. ✅ Pastikan menu sudah ter-insert (cek dengan query verifikasi)
2. ✅ Pastikan permission sudah di-set untuk user role
3. ✅ Pastikan user login dengan role yang memiliki permission
4. ✅ Refresh browser atau clear cache
5. ✅ Cek console untuk error

### Permission tidak ter-insert?

1. ✅ Cek apakah role_id yang digunakan sudah benar
2. ✅ Cek apakah userCompanyRole dengan role tersebut ada
3. ✅ Cek apakah ada constraint violation (unique constraint)
4. ✅ Jalankan query verifikasi untuk melihat detail error

### Path tidak sesuai?

1. ✅ Pastikan path di database sesuai dengan routing Next.js
2. ✅ Pastikan route group `(dashboard)` atau `(admin)` tidak mempengaruhi path
3. ✅ Cek Next.js routing di `app/` directory

## 📝 Notes

- Script menggunakan `WHERE NOT EXISTS` untuk prevent duplicate
- ID menu bisa di-adjust jika sudah terpakai
- Permission otomatis di-set untuk semua admin roles (Option B recommended)
- Script aman untuk dijalankan multiple times (idempotent)

---

**Done!** 🎉

**Cursor**


Memperbaiki script SQL agar menggunakan double quotes untuk nama tabel dan kolom yang lebih dari satu suku kata atau mixed case di PostgreSQL:


```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- INSERT MENU UNTUK ADMIN PANEL (admin-ngebengkel)
-- ============================================================================
-- Script ini untuk membuat menu di admin panel yang terpisah dari client-ngebengkel
-- Admin panel digunakan untuk mengatur seluruh workshop dan waiting list
-- 
-- Cara menjalankan:
-- 1. Buka database client (pgAdmin, DBeaver, atau psql)
-- 2. Connect ke database ngebengkel
-- 3. Copy paste dan jalankan script ini
-- 4. Setelah menu ter-insert, set permission untuk admin roles
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- PART 1: INSERT MENU ITEMS
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Insert parent menu "Admin Panel" atau "Workshop Management"
-- ID 18 digunakan (cek dulu apakah sudah terpakai, adjust jika perlu)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)
  'Admin Panel',  -- Judul menu (bisa diganti: "Workshop Management", "System Admin", dll)
  NULL,  -- Tidak ada href untuk parent menu
  'SYS',  -- Module System (atau bisa 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai)
  'menu',  -- Tipe menu
  true,  -- Memiliki child

  true,  -- can_delete

-- 1. Insert parent menu "Admin Panel" atau "Workshop Management"
-- ID 18 digunakan (cek dulu apakah sudah terpakai, adjust jika perlu)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)
  'Admin Panel',  -- Judul menu (bisa diganti: "Workshop Management", "System Admin", dll)
  NULL,  -- Tidak ada href untuk parent menu
  'SYS',  -- Module System (atau bisa 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai)
  'menu',  -- Tipe menu
  true,  -- Memiliki child
  'Settings',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Shield", "Cog", "Wrench", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 18
);

-- 2. Insert submenu "Manage Workshops" (untuk mengatur seluruh workshop)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")

  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)

-- 1. Insert parent menu "Admin Panel" atau "Workshop Management"
-- ID 18 digunakan (cek dulu apakah sudah terpakai, adjust jika perlu)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)
  'Admin Panel',  -- Judul menu (bisa diganti: "Workshop Management", "System Admin", dll)
  NULL,  -- Tidak ada href untuk parent menu
  'SYS',  -- Module System (atau bisa 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai)
  'menu',  -- Tipe menu
  true,  -- Memiliki child
  'Settings',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Shield", "Cog", "Wrench", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 18
);

-- 2. Insert submenu "Manage Workshops" (untuk mengatur seluruh workshop)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  19,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Manage Workshops',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/workshops',  -- Path ke halaman (adjust sesuai routing admin-ngebengkel)
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'Building',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Store", "Building2", "Factory", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 19
);

  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view

  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print

## Summary Perbaikan

### File yang diperbaiki

1. **`seed-admin-panel-menu.sql`**
   - Semua `INSERT INTO` menggunakan double quotes
   - Semua `SELECT FROM` menggunakan double quotes
   - Semua `JOIN` menggunakan double quotes
   - Semua `WHERE` clauses menggunakan double quotes
   - Verification queries (commented) juga menggunakan double quotes

2. **`seed-waiting-list-menu.sql`**
   - Semua statement menggunakan double quotes untuk konsistensi

**Sebelum:**

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  COALESCE((SELECT MAX("id") FROM "sys_Menu_Permission"), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create

  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy

FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"

-- Script ini akan otomatis set permission untuk semua userCompanyRole yang memiliki

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  COALESCE((SELECT MAX("id") FROM "sys_Menu_Permission"), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create
  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"
WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu_Permission" 
    WHERE "userCompanyRole_id" = ucr."id" AND "menu_id" = 18
  );

  COALESCE((SELECT MAX("id") FROM "sys_Menu_Permission"), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  19,  -- menu_id (Manage Workshops)
  true,  -- can_view

  NOW()  -- createdAt

WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu_Permission" 
    WHERE "userCompanyRole_id" = ucr."id" AND "menu_id" = 19
  );

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  COALESCE((SELECT MAX("id") FROM "sys_Menu_Permission"), 0) + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create
  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"

  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'

  );

INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)

  'Settings',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Shield", "Cog", "Wrench", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by

  NOW()  -- Updated at

  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 18
);

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("id"), 0) FROM "sys_Menu_Permission") + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create
  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"
WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("id"), 0) FROM "sys_Menu_Permission") + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create
  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"
WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu_Permission" 
    WHERE "userCompanyRole_id" = ucr."id" AND "menu_id" = 18
  );

```sql
-- ============================================================================
-- INSERT MENU UNTUK ADMIN PANEL (admin-ngebengkel)
-- ============================================================================
-- Script ini untuk membuat menu di admin panel yang terpisah dari client-ngebengkel
-- Admin panel digunakan untuk mengatur seluruh workshop dan waiting list
-- 
-- Cara menjalankan:
-- 1. Buka database client (pgAdmin, DBeaver, atau psql)
-- 2. Connect ke database ngebengkel
-- 3. Copy paste dan jalankan script ini
-- 4. Setelah menu ter-insert, set permission untuk admin roles
-- ============================================================================

-- ============================================================================
-- PART 1: INSERT MENU ITEMS
-- ============================================================================

-- 1. Insert parent menu "Admin Panel" atau "Workshop Management"
-- ID 18 digunakan (cek dulu apakah sudah terpakai, adjust jika perlu)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  18,  -- ID baru (adjust jika sudah terpakai)
  NULL,  -- Parent menu (tidak ada parent)
  'Admin Panel',  -- Judul menu (bisa diganti: "Workshop Management", "System Admin", dll)
  NULL,  -- Tidak ada href untuk parent menu
  'SYS',  -- Module System (atau bisa 'WKS' jika lebih sesuai)
  'menu',  -- Tipe menu
  true,  -- Memiliki child
  'Settings',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Shield", "Cog", "Wrench", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 18
);

-- 2. Insert submenu "Manage Workshops" (untuk mengatur seluruh workshop)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  19,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Manage Workshops',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/workshops',  -- Path ke halaman (adjust sesuai routing admin-ngebengkel)
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'Building',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "Store", "Building2", "Factory", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 19
);

-- 3. Insert submenu "Manage Waiting List" (untuk mengatur seluruh waiting list)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  20,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Manage Waiting List',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/waiting-list',  -- Path ke halaman (adjust sesuai routing admin-ngebengkel)
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'List',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "FileText", "ClipboardList", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 20
);

-- 4. (Optional) Insert submenu "Workshop Analytics" atau menu lain yang diperlukan
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu" ("id", "parent_id", "menu_description", "href", "module_id", "menu_type", "has_child", "icon", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt", "updatedAt")
SELECT 
  21,  -- ID baru
  18,  -- Parent ID (Admin Panel menu)
  'Workshop Analytics',  -- Judul submenu
  '/admin/analytics',  -- Path ke halaman
  'SYS',  -- Module System
  'submenu',  -- Tipe submenu
  false,  -- Tidak memiliki child
  'BarChart',  -- Icon (bisa diganti: "TrendingUp", "Activity", dll)
  '1',  -- Status aktif
  'system',  -- Created by
  NOW(),  -- Created at
  NOW()  -- Updated at
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu" WHERE "id" = 21
);

-- ============================================================================
-- OPTION B: Set Permission untuk Semua Admin Roles (Recommended)
-- ============================================================================
-- Script ini akan otomatis set permission untuk semua userCompanyRole yang memiliki
-- role_id = 'ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', atau 'OWNER'
-- Sesuaikan role_id sesuai dengan role yang ada di sistem Anda

-- Permission untuk parent menu "Admin Panel" (id=18)
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", "menu_id", "can_view", "can_create", "can_edit", "can_delete", "can_print", "can_approve", "iStatus", "createdBy", "createdAt")
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("id"), 0) FROM "sys_Menu_Permission") + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),  -- Generate ID otomatis
  ucr."id",  -- userCompanyRole_id
  18,  -- menu_id (Admin Panel)
  true,  -- can_view
  true,  -- can_create
  true,  -- can_edit
  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"
WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM "sys_Menu_Permission" 
    WHERE "userCompanyRole_id" = ucr."id" AND "menu_id" = 18
  );

-- Permission untuk "Manage Workshops" (id=19)

  19,  -- menu_id (Manage Workshops)

  true,  -- can_delete
  false,  -- can_print
  true,  -- can_approve
  'Active',  -- iStatus
  'system',  -- createdBy
  NOW()  -- createdAt
FROM "sys_UserCompanyRole" ucr
JOIN "sys_UserRole" ur ON ucr."userRole_id" = ur."id"
WHERE ur."role_id" IN ('ADMIN', 'SUPER_ADMIN', 'OWNER')  -- Sesuaikan dengan role yang ada
  AND ucr."iStatus" = 'Active'
  AND NOT EXISTS (

Semua INSERT statement sudah diperbaiki. Ringkasan perubahan:

## Perbaikan yang dilakukan

### Masalah
- Kolom `id` di `sys_Menu_Permission` tidak boleh NULL
- Schema tidak memiliki `@default(autoincrement())`, jadi ID harus di-generate manual

### Solusi
Menambahkan kolom `"id"` di semua INSERT statement dengan generate ID otomatis:

**Untuk batch insert (OPTION B - Recommended):**
```sql
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", ...)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("id"), 0) FROM "sys_Menu_Permission") + ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ucr."id"),
  ...
```

**Untuk single insert (OPTION A - Commented):**
```sql
INSERT INTO "sys_Menu_Permission" ("id", "userCompanyRole_id", ...)
SELECT 
  (SELECT COALESCE(MAX("id"), 0) FROM "sys_Menu_Permission") + 1,
  ...
```

### Yang sudah diperbaiki
1. Semua INSERT di OPTION B (4 menu: 18, 19, 20, 21)
2. Semua INSERT di OPTION A (commented, untuk referensi)

### Cara kerja
- Mengambil MAX(`id`) dari tabel `sys_Menu_Permission`
- Jika tabel kosong, menggunakan 0 sebagai base
- Menambahkan `ROW_NUMBER()` untuk batch insert atau `+ 1` untuk single insert
- Menghasilkan ID unik secara otomatis

Script siap dijalankan. Error "null value in column id" seharusnya sudah teratasi.
